question: Which university won the first place in the 3rd Khelo India University Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panjab University**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panjab University** won the first place in the 3rd Khelo India University Games.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is a part of the Khelo India initiative, which aims to promote sports education and infrastructure across universities in India.
 
• The event saw participation from numerous universities across the country, competing in various sports disciplines.
 
• Panjab University emerged as the overall champion, showcasing exceptional performance and securing the top position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India initiative was launched by the Government of India to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is one of the largest university-level sports events in the country.
 
• The initiative aims to identify and nurture young sports talent, providing them with the necessary support and infrastructure to excel in their respective sports.
 
• The 3rd edition of the Khelo India University Games witnessed record participation and was held at various venues, ensuring a wide reach and impact.
 
• The success of Panjab University in the games highlights the importance of sports education and the role of universities in promoting a sporting culture.
